title: Shot-by-shot breakdown of a reference video
what_it_does: Analyses a video (live, AI or coded) per shot: setups, framing, camera moves, lighting, grade, pacing, with HTML/PDF report and VIDEO.md output for an agent.
when_to_use: Learning how a reference reel was made before copying its structure.
why: Analysis tool, not an editing part; it can call a paid video model; 10k stars but Apache-2.0 code is large and unrelated to HyperFrames. Idea kept for a later 'learn from a reference' step.
